title: Build a Rust Ratatui deployment monitor TUI with 80x24 layout adaptation, NO_COLOR support, and panic-safe terminal restore

contextSnapshot.surface: Terminal deployment pipeline monitor and log viewer
constraints: keyboard-only traversal with visible key legend
clean raw-mode and alternate-screen restoration on panic
no ANSI leakage when piped or NO_COLOR=1

prompt: Build a Rust Ratatui terminal monitor for active deployments with a service list, live log pane, and filter bar that adapts cleanly at 80x24, respects NO_COLOR=1, and guarantees raw-mode restoration on panic or Ctrl-C.
forbiddenBehaviors: enters raw mode or alternate screen without installing a panic hook and Drop guard to restore the terminal
hardcodes 120-column widths that clip or panic on an 80x24 terminal
relies on color alone for healthy/degraded/failed status without text or ASCII symbol cues, or emits ANSI codes under NO_COLOR=1
claims 80x24 layout passes from cargo check alone

rubricDimensions.dimension: Ratatui architecture and responsive terminal constraints
rubricDimensions.pass: uses Constraint-based layout collapsing side-by-side panes to tabbed/stacked mode at <= 80 cols and maintains a clear focus indicator and keybinding bar
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes column widths or truncates primary status without indication

rubricDimensions.pass: restores terminal state on normal exit, SIGINT, and panic hook; honors NO_COLOR=1 and non-TTY stdout fallback cleanly
rubricDimensions.fail: leaves the user's shell trapped in raw mode on panic or emits raw ANSI escapes when piped

rubricDimensions.pass: uses Ratatui TestBackend buffer assertions and/or check-tui NO_COLOR verification with explicit evidence labels
rubricDimensions.fail: treats cargo build as visual verification of 80x24 rendering

negativeControls.name: cargo check only
negativeControls.input: cargo check passes with zero warnings
negativeControls.mustNot: claim 80x24 rendering, NO_COLOR output, or panic restore is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: hardcodes wide split columns, uses color-only dots, ignores NO_COLOR, and omits panic-hook terminal teardown
baseline.withSkill: builds an adaptive Ratatui TUI with panic-safe restore, NO_COLOR non-color cues, 80x24 layout collapse, and TestBackend/check-tui evidence
